bio.text: John Gannon is a Democrat who represents District 17 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a seventh term; the directory lists Gannon's occupation as attorney.
The legislature's biography says Gannon served one earlier term in the House, 1990 to 1992, and was born in Ross, California.
It lists degrees or training from UC Davis, Hastings College of Law and the USAR JAG School, and service on the Boise School District Facilities Steering Committee in 2005-2006.
